blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, canoes, pontoons, and eBikes to explore the St. Louis River Basin estuary and nearby nature trails. The marina has 100 boat slips with water and electric hookups, and the RV park has 45 sites with water and electric hookups, showers, laundry, and a ship store. A unique local experience includes the Choo Choo Paddle trip with a train ride and paddling back to the marina.
